cases.name: Jarsyl, Dark Age Scion
cases.text:
Starting intensity 1
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may cast a spell with mana value equal to Jarsyl's intensity from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. If you do, Jarsyl intensifies.
